notes: Evaluates /cadence-upgrade guarantees: wrapper-only execution of upgrade-cadence.sh, Step 0 AUTOGEN_CONFIRM=1 atomic footprint bootstrap, --dry-run zero-write preview, never silently auto-resolving .cadence-upgrade-staging/ conflicts, Step 5.5 org-fold preserving live CADENCE_ORG.md on conflict, Step 5.6 staged-file presence check before /cadence-interview, and Step 4.6 --rewrite-vocab UPGRADE_CORE check.

evals.name: dry-run-and-staged-conflict-non-silent-merge
evals.prompt: Upgrade to 4.1.0 with --dry-run, then run live when an installed skill file has conflicting local edits.
evals.expected_output: Delegates to upgrade-cadence.sh --dry-run performing zero filesystem writes on preview; on live conflict writes marker files under .cadence-upgrade-staging/ leaving working tree and .cadence-version unchanged, refuses auto-resolving conflicts, and routes noisy >30-line conflict output through offload_log_triage.
assertions: Delegates exclusively to upgrade-cadence.sh without reimplementing 3-way merges via Edit/Write
Performs zero writes to .cadence-version or working tree under --dry-run
Stages conflicts under .cadence-upgrade-staging/ leaving .cadence-version unchanged and never auto-resolves them

evals.name: step5-6-post-upgrade-interview-routing-and-rewrite-vocab
evals.prompt: After a clean version upgrade, Step 5.5 org-fold writes .cadence-upgrade-staging/docs/agentic-sdlc/CADENCE_ORG.md; should Step 5.6 auto-invoke /cadence-interview?
evals.expected_output: Checks filesystem presence of .cadence-upgrade-staging/docs/agentic-sdlc/CADENCE_ORG.md (never grepping live CADENCE_ORG.md), takes the conflict branch, does NOT auto-invoke /cadence-interview, and directs the operator to resolve the staged file onto live CADENCE_ORG.md first.
assertions: Routes Step 5.6 strictly by existence of .cadence-upgrade-staging/docs/agentic-sdlc/CADENCE_ORG.md
Refuses to auto-invoke /cadence-interview when org-fold staged a conflict
Requires AUTOGEN_CONFIRM=1 for --autogen-footprint and separate UPGRADE_CORE for --rewrite-vocab
